title: CodeCraft
description: A competitive Survival-PvP experience featuring a player-driven economy, custom reward systems, and a community-focused building environment.
body:
# Welcome to CodeCraft MC

Are you looking for a place where your building skills and combat prowess actually matter? **CodeCraft MC** offers a high-stakes Survival-PvP experience combined with a community-driven environment.

### ⚔️ Competitive PvP & Survival
Test your strength against other players in our open-world PvP environment. Build massive bases, form alliances, or go solo as a lone wolf. The world is yours to conquer, but be prepared to defend what you build!

### 📦 Custom Crates & Rewards
Progress through our unique reward system. Use keys earned through gameplay to open **Custom Crates**, which contain:
* Rare enchantments and powerful gear.
* Unique vanity items to stand out from the crowd.
* Essential survival resources to boost your start.

### ⚖️ Player Economy & Shop
Trade your way to the top! Our integrated **Server Shop** and economy system allow you to sell your gathered resources and buy the blocks or equipment you need for your next big project. 

### 🛡️ Why Join CodeCraft MC?
Unlike generic servers, we focus on a balanced gameplay experience where both builders and fighters find their place. We offer:
* **Active Moderation:** A fair environment for everyone.
* **Performance:** Low-lag experience for smooth PvP encounters.
* **Unique Features:** Custom-tuned plugins that enhance the vanilla experience without breaking it.

**Join us today and leave your mark on the world of CodeCraft MC!**
